Asia Pacific Tours can I help you? Yes, I've been looking at your website and I'd like
some more information about your activity holidays. Certainly. You know of course the
prices of the tours include stays in three-star hotels and they include airfares. Great! What
about your tour of Vietnam? My sister went there last year and loved it. Yes, it's a
really beautiful place and probably our fastest growing destination. Now that package includes
several opportunities to take courses. Don't you have a cookery course of some kind? We
certainly do. If you love eating out in Vietnam like most people do and want to know how to
prepare a meal you can learn how from a master in a five-star hotel. On another day you have
a choice of two activities. The first is instruction in diving in the South China Sea. Not a certificate
course but just an introduction. Most people think it's wonderful. Or if you want to stay
dry but still want some exercise you can spend the day on a trek through the jungle near
the beach. It's not difficult and everyone seems to enjoy it. Anything cultural on offer?
We used to take people to a Vietnamese opera but that didn't prove so popular. So now we
include a dance show and our clients all rave about that. They say the colours are just
magnificent. What's the cost? I've just noticed it's now a special price. The holiday used
to be £1,600 but it's just been reduced to £1,450 so you do save quite a bit and as
I said it seems to be our up-and-coming tour. Well, let's see. Perhaps you could tell me
a little about the Hong Kong tour. I noticed it includes a walk in the hills of one of
their country parks where you have the chance to see birds of all sorts. Yes, that's a very
popular activity. People don't realise that Hong Kong isn't just a crowded city. That's
a half-day activity and you go with a trained escort and it includes dinner in a monastery
where you end your day. And then we wouldn't want you to miss out altogether on shopping
so there's another day when we take you around an electronics factory. Now, that might sound
like an odd thing to do but it's actually really fascinating and not like your usual
ceramics factory and you can buy their products there quite cheaply. Now, the whole Hong Kong
package is just £1,320 per person. Sounds interesting.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 8-10
But let me find out about one more place. I've always wanted to go to Korea but not
on this trip. And I've been to Thailand which I loved but what about your Japan package?
Good choice. Well, that tour includes a terrific trip to a museum of traditional costume. The
exhibits are gorgeous. They've got an absolutely priceless collection. And I think the website
says you take your clients to a market, don't you? A crafts market I think. Well, we do
go to a market but it's one that sells fish and it's one of the largest in the world.
And you have the chance to sample the wares in a little restaurant nearby. We also give
you plenty of free time to wander around the city with our guides if you want. And what's
the cost of all that? £1,800. Well, you've been ever so helpful. I've noted all the details
down and I'll get back to you when I've made up my mind. If we can give you any more help,
do ring back. Thanks, I will.
Joy in Litz. That is the end of section 1. You now have
half a minute to check your answers. Joy in Litz.
